claim_ceiling: Protocol only. No model, renderer, driving performance, safety or transfer result is claimed by this manifest.
hypotheses: A learned visual front-end with structured HDC scene binding and continuous-time HDC-LTC/CfC memory can improve temporal irregularity, memory efficiency, missing-sensor robustness or adaptation cost versus matched compact recurrent and transformer baselines.
Action-conditioned latent prediction can improve closed-loop decision quality only when trained/evaluated on action-observation transitions under matched data and compute.

Decision-sensitive experience selection can reach a frozen competence gate with fewer simulator transitions or human intervention minutes than uniform sampling without worsening worst-family constraints.

At matched experience and human-label budgets, decision-sensitive experience selection (#4575) can reduce transitions/interventions per frozen skill gate compared with uniform, rarity, entropy and prediction-error baselines.

At a fixed inference compute and deadline budget, anytime imagination allocation (#4581) can improve decision quality by spending additional rollouts only where marginal regret reduction is positive and the actuation/recovery reserve remains intact.

comparator_register.name: NHTSA Part 573 Safety Recall Report 26E035 — freeway construction-zone entry
capabilities: Official recall report identifies failure to recognize ramp-closure signs and entry into pre-planned freeway construction zones in Phoenix on events from 11 and 19 April 2026
Report also describes seven events on 18 May 2026 in which vehicles entered freeway lanes between cones designating a lane closure in the San Francisco Bay Area
Manufacturer report attributes behavior to prioritizing avoidance of other freeway hazards and/or failing to recognize the construction zone
Described software remedy includes improved awareness/response to freeway closures and detecting when the ADS is inside a construction zone, plus operational protocols
comparator_register.protocol: Regulatory recall narrative and event chronology only. The report is not a controlled benchmark, fleet failure-rate denominator, independent root-cause study or estimate of public-road prevalence. Use it to motivate scenario families and negative controls, not to rank systems.

pairing_requirements: identical scenario family, scenario cluster and disposition for each episode
explicit finite non-null native metric for every paired episode
same evaluator, split, seed manifest, policy inputs and teacher privileges
statistical_method.estimator: mean of scenario-cluster means of candidate-minus-baseline native metric differences
statistical_method.resampling: 10,000 deterministic percentile-bootstrap replicates; sample scenario clusters with replacement within each scenario_family while preserving family cluster counts
statistical_method.claim_ceiling: Unadjusted percentile bootstrap interval, not multiplicity-adjusted; one primary metric must be preregistered. This is benchmark uncertainty, not safety assurance.
statistical_method.missing_data: Reject paired inferential comparison when any episode is unmatched or its requested metric is null; never silently drop or impute an episode.
